purpose: Authoritative top-level admission policy joining maintenance/return-to-service evidence, certified operating-envelope compatibility, and family-specific route safety. A favorable route calculation may not erase a blocking maintenance or envelope state, and machinery condition may not select transit family.

designIntentSource.title: The different lightspeed methods
designIntentSource.role: Governing design intent for differentiated FTL hazards, gravity sensitivity, predictive sensing, emergency de-transit, maturity-scaled safety, and technical depth.

admissionOrder: resolve maintenance evidence when required or supplied
validate maintenance evidence freshness when an explicit validity interval is supplied
resolve certified operating-envelope compatibility when required or supplied
block on maintenance, envelope, or provenance conflict
block as UNRESOLVED when required maintenance or envelope evidence is absent or unresolved
block before route evaluation when the requested operating point lies outside the certified envelope
combine all gates conjunctively so no favorable gate can average away another blocker
downgrade otherwise-ADMISSIBLE route results when maintenance or envelope certification is conditional

implicitTriggers: technologyAdapter supplied for a service/re-certification request
maintenanceRequirement.noTriggerBehavior: Route safety may proceed using existing installation timing/readiness authority; no recent maintenance event is invented.

operatingEnvelopeRequirement.noTriggerBehavior: No certified capability envelope is invented when no envelope authority or requested operating point is supplied.

conjunctivePolicy: Any maintenance, operating-envelope, or route BLOCK state produces rejected admission.
Required UNRESOLVED maintenance or operating-envelope evidence produces UNRESOLVED admission.
A conditional maintenance or envelope state downgrades an otherwise ADMISSIBLE route to MARGINAL.
A route MARGINAL state remains MARGINAL even when prior engineering gates fully pass.
SIMULATION_ONLY evidence can never become operationally ADMISSIBLE.

freshnessPolicy.validityRule: When maintenanceEvidenceValiditySeconds is explicitly supplied, age greater than the validity interval makes required maintenance evidence UNRESOLVED.
freshnessPolicy.safeguard: No universal certificate lifetime is invented. Omitted validity remains governed by the underlying technology/service authority.

operatingEnvelopePolicy.scalarContainment: For certified [L_c,U_c] and requested [L_r,U_r], require L_r >= L_c and U_r <= U_c.
operatingEnvelopePolicy.coupledConstraint: For a^T x <= b and interval variables, evaluate worst case sum_i max(a_i L_i, a_i U_i) <= b.
operatingEnvelopePolicy.partialOverlap: Partial overlap does not constitute certification and blocks the requested operating interval.
operatingEnvelopePolicy.conditionalBoundary: Near-boundary CONDITIONAL status is permitted only when an applicable certificate explicitly supplies an advisory margin.
operatingEnvelopePolicy.unitRule: No implicit unit conversion is performed by route admission. Unnormalized unit mismatch remains UNRESOLVED.

physicalSafeguards: Maintenance health is not route-environment health.
Certified operating-envelope compatibility is not family-specific route safety.
Route-environment safety is not proof of machinery health or unlimited capability.
Stored energy adequacy is distinct from instantaneous power delivery adequacy.
Reachable infrastructure is distinct from timely infrastructure and both are distinct from certification.
PRECOMMIT families use prediction/intervention timing rather than fabricated local FTL velocity.
Anchored portal systems use admission, synchronization, aperture/throat, exit, clearance, and recovery semantics rather than free-flight velocity.
Species or technology basis never selects FTL family.

raceTechnologySafeguards.arnock: Default to solid-state electromechanical modular machinery, silicon computation, piezoelectric diagnostics, explicit module/interface bounds, thermal qualification, timing, and protected stores. Biotechnology remains secondary unless a narrower source establishes an exception.
raceTechnologySafeguards.zwleiMurrek: Preserve field-vane, dielectric-fluid, hydraulic, bio-reactive power-fluid, coolant, Navigation Current, and sensor evidence without normalizing the source term 'gravitic slipstream' into a consolidated family.

provenanceRule: The route-admission packet must retain the complete maintenance packet, operating-envelope packet, complete route-safety result, authority references, warnings, and the reason for any disposition downgrade or block.
